CALIFORNIA COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
This Lease Agreement made the 2025-07-07, by and between Stewart Abbott [name of lessor], of
2896 Ward Rapid [street address], State of California, hereinafter referred to as "Lessor", and
Schwalter, Beer and Zemlak [name of lessee], of 1230 Elda Divide [street address], State of California, hereinafter referred to as "Lessee", collectively referred to herein as the "Parties", agree as follows:
1. DESCRIPTION OF LEASED PREMISES:
The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described ___ square feet (SF) of Retail Space located at 580 Birch Close [street address], State of California.
2. TERM OF LEASE:
The term of this Lease shall be for a period of 3 year(s) 10 month(s) commencing on the 7 day of July 2025, and expiring at Midnight on the 7 day of May 2029. ("Initial Term")
3. BASE RENT:
The net monthly payment shall be 1769 dollars ($7769) per month. A security deposit of 6519 dollars ($6579) is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month
4. Options to Renew (Check one):
✓ Lessee may not renew the Lease.
✓ The Lessee may have the right to renew the Lease with a total of ___ renewal period(s) with each term being ___ year(s) ___ month(s) which may be exercised by giving written notice to Lessor no less than 60 days prior to the expiration of the Lease or renewal period.
